skill_name: Add 5 new facts to the article.
workflow: In the United States, the number of workers age 65 and above is projected to double by 2040. Additionally, in 2020, older workers represent one quarter of the country's employed labor force, with their participation in the labor force rising from 12.7% in 1979 to 25.3%. By 2040, older workers are expected to make up nearly one-third of the U.S. labor force.
